market_context: U.S. equities are mixed late in the session: SPY is slightly lower, QQQ is under pressure, while DIA and IWM are higher; volatility is elevated with VIX at 20.71 and the 10-year yield at 4.89%. October ISM manufacturing was reported at 55.5 versus 54.5 previously, while Apple reports after the close with consensus EPS near $1.99 and revenue around $113.4 billion; margin pressure from rising memory costs and uncertainty around holiday guidance are key risks.

predictions.reasoning: SPY is only 0.10% below its prior close after trading as low as $753.11, suggesting some late-session stabilization. A stronger-than-expected ISM manufacturing reading and relative strength in industrial and small-cap shares support a modest rebound into the close.

QQQ is down 0.79% and has materially underperformed SPY over five sessions, with the technology complex remaining sensitive to the 4.89% 10-year yield. Apple’s after-close earnings risk and weakness in Microsoft and Meta increase the likelihood of continued late-session Nasdaq pressure.

Apple is already down 1.74% ahead of its post-close report, and the earnings preview highlights rising memory costs, a difficult gross-margin comparison, and investor focus on holiday guidance and AI plans. With results arriving after the closing bell, pre-earnings risk reduction favors additional weakness during the remaining regular session.

DIA is up 0.70% while QQQ is falling, indicating rotation toward industrial and value-oriented components. The positive ISM manufacturing result supports that leadership persisting through the close, although the elevated VIX limits the expected gain.

Amazon is one of the strongest major technology names today, up 3.24% despite broader Nasdaq weakness. Its positive momentum and relative resilience suggest buyers may continue supporting the stock into the close, though the broad risk-off tone makes the signal moderate rather than strong.
